jobs.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc's most important asset is our people. As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you will own a territory of Mid-Market clients and grow it by generating new business, not by waiting on renewals. jobs.description_text: About Trakka Systems Trakka Systems is a global leader in the design, development, and manufacture of mission-critical vision, surveillance, and situational awareness solutions for airborne, maritime, and land-based operations. jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, California/Washington
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per account for 2–3 days (supporting accounts in Northern California and the Seattle, Washington area). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, meaning some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is a remote role, but candidates must be based on the West Coast (preferably within driving distance or short regional flight access to Northern California or the Seattle, WA area) to accommodate monthly client visits.

jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan
jobs.description_text: The Care Manager will work with primary care practices as a part of the Provider Delivered Care Management Program (PDCMP). The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant (EA) serves as a strategic executive business partner supporting 3-4 assigned senior leadership members (SVPs+). Moving beyond traditional administrative support, the EA leverages organizational insight to optimize executive efficacy, proactively mitigate operational risks, and streamline cross-functional workflows. Operating in a fast-paced environment, this role acts as a trusted gatekeeper and operational liaison, ensuring leadership focus remains strictly aligned with company priorities.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Minnesota
jobs.description_text: Executive Directors, Enterprise Partnerships are the business leads for large, strategic hospital and health system accounts. They act as a link between the field and Aledade Centralized support teams, focusing on ACO-specific business operations. Executive Directors partner with Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. The Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, will be pivotal in building Aledade’s service model in the Minnesota market and beyond for a core group of strategic partners.

jobs.title: Payer Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Payer Data Operations Analyst ensures data quality, accuracy, and reliability across payer data pipelines to support value-based contract performance. This role applies technical data skills and cross-functional leadership to resolve complex data issues, build proactive monitoring solutions, and partner with internal teams and payers to continuously enhance end-to-end data integrity.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs
jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $80,000—$92,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (Remote)
jobs.description_text: Aledade is seeking a Senior Counsel to join our Privacy Team, reporting to our Privacy Officer and Associate General Counsel. The ideal candidate will work independently to advise on privacy risk, own key privacy verticals end-to-end, and serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders on evolving privacy and AI regulatory issues. The successful candidate must bring strong legal judgment, confidence using AI tools to work efficiently, and enthusiasm for advising the business on emerging AI laws and governance frameworks. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

jobs.title: Vice President,  Payer Engagement (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Vice President, Payer Engagement leads post-contract payer partnerships and executive health plan relationships to drive value-based care success and practice participation. In this high-visibility role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior health plan executives, translating post-contract relationships into lasting, mutually beneficial success for practices, payers, and Aledade alike. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution—leading governance forums, shaping Medicare Advantage strategy, and rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision for better outcomes. If you're energized by building high-trust executive relationships, driving measurable results in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment, and leading a team that thrives on collaboration and impact, this is your opportunity to shape what payer partnership looks like in value-based care. jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.location_raw: College Park, MD | Columbus, OH | Boston, MA
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
